chapterUpserts.title: Walter, Susan and David
chapterUpserts.summary: Ruth married Walter in 1958, the same year she started teaching. They had two children, Susan and David. Walter died in 2011.
openQuestions: Where did she and Walter meet?

openQuestionAdds: Are there photographs of the wedding?

anecdoteAdds.text: She married Walter in 1958, the same year she walked into her first classroom. She used to say she got the whole of her life in one go that year.
